vendor.blurb: GPT-6 Astra tops coding and agents, images sweep the top 3; Sora is shut down.

gpt-6-astra.tagline: New flagship, the best at agents and bug hunting
highlights: Code Arena 1792, #2 behind only Opus 5.5
Bug Hunt Bench: fixes 45 of 105 bugs, the most
Terminal-Bench 4.0 57.7%, OSWorld 2.0 72.6%
FrontierMath T4 97.6%, ARC-AGI-3 99.9%
gpt-6-astra.notes: Reasoning levels low to max merged. DevDay added an Ultrafast speed tier (up to 300 tokens/s, 6x price). Only #30 on the Text Arena; strengths are agents and coding. 6.1 Astra has been canceled.

bench.Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: max; tied #3 after per-model dedup (behind Opus 5.5 at 58 and Sonnet 5.5 at 56; level with Fable 5.1 and Gemini 4 Argon at 53; pulled 10/1)

gpt-6-astra.pricing: $10 / $50 per 1M tokens (cached input $1; Fast mode at 2x, Ultrafast at 6x)

gpt-6-sol.tagline: Astra's training recipe, at half the price
highlights: Price cut 50% from GPT-5.6 Sol's promo rate, now $2/$10
Code Arena 1681, #5; AA Intelligence Index 48
AutomationBench 33.2% at just 9% of Opus 5's cost
Internal factuality error rate about half that of GPT-5.6 Sol
gpt-6-sol.notes: Reasoning levels none to max merged. Replaced by the same-priced GPT-6.1 Sol 7 days after launch (no retirement notice seen); its writing blind-test results are actually better than 6.1 Sol.

bench.Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: max; replaced by GPT-6.1 Sol (52) just 7 days after launch

gpt-6-luna.tagline: A dime per million tokens: the volume workhorse
highlights: $0.10 input, $0.50 output; free users get it on desktop
OSWorld 2.0 offline 58.1%, beating 5.6 Sol at 1/10 the cost
DeepSWE v1.1 66.6%, only 2.2 points below Sol
gpt-6-luna.notes: Reasoning levels merged. A Japanese tier chart puts it in A; by AA index (37, below 5.6 Terra's 42) we rate it at the top of B. Faster and more accurate after the launch vision bug fix.

gpt-5-6-sol.tagline: Last-gen flagship, OpenAI's best on Text Arena
highlights: LMArena Text 1483, #19, OpenAI's highest overall
Ties Opus 5.5 on Bug Hunt Bench, behind only Astra
AA Coding Agent Index 80 at launch, #1
MRCR v2 256K–512K long-context retrieval 91.5%
gpt-5-6-sol.notes: Limited preview June 26, general launch July 9. Reasoning levels merged. Replaced by GPT-6 Sol at half the price.

bench.Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: Current-version index; old-version index at launch was 59, #2

gpt-5-6-terra.tagline: Mid-tier of the GPT-5.6 family, the daily driver
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 42; old-version index at launch was 55
Price cut 20% on July 30, from $2.5/$15 to $2/$12
Internal Codex users say it is being replaced by GPT-6 Sol (medium)
gpt-5-6-terra.notes: Reasoning levels merged. The community broadly sees GPT-6 Sol as roughly equal to 5.6 Terra in ability, at a comparable price.

highlights: Price cut 80% on July 30, from $1/$6 to $0.20/$1.20
Old-version AA index 51 at launch
Replaced by GPT-6 Luna at half the price again

gpt-5-5.tagline: Two flagships back, still fighting on Text Arena
highlights: LMArena Text 1481, #21, above GPT-6 Astra
Terminal-Bench 2.0 82.7%, FrontierMath T4 35.4%
GPT-5.5 Instant became the free-tier default from May
gpt-5-5.notes: Ships as Thinking / Pro / Instant; there is also GPT-5.5-Cyber (5/7) for security teams. Once teased for its habit of mentioning goblins in code.

gpt-oss-120b.tagline: OpenAI's only open weights, runs on one 80GB GPU
highlights: Apache 2.0 license; inference on a single 80GB GPU
AA Intelligence Index 12, #9 among open models this size, above the median of 8
~234 tokens/s output; still a common local-deployment pick
gpt-oss-120b.notes: gpt-oss-20b came out alongside it. Not updated in over a year and now far behind open models like Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8; gpt-oss-2 is only community hope.

bench.Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: high, #9/65 among open models this size

gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.tagline: #1 on both text-to-image and image-edit arenas
highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1424, #1, nearly 90 points ahead of the top non-OpenAI model at #4
LMArena image edit 1526, #1, 44 points above #2
Up to 16 reference images; new xhigh / max quality tiers
gpt-image-2-5-sunburst.notes: The high-end API tier of ChatGPT Images 2.5, built for refinement and multi-turn editing. Community complaints: noise artifacts unfixed, strict moderation; no Batch API support.

gpt-image-2-5-flare.tagline: Default tier: half the latency, better looking
highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1401, image edit 1482, #2 on both
Higher quality than GPT-Image-2 with 50% lower latency
OpenAI's recommended default for most apps
gpt-image-2-5-flare.notes: No Batch API support, so bulk generation costs more than with GPT-Image-2.

gpt-image-2.tagline: Last gen, still #3 on both arenas
highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1383, image edit 1461, #3 on both
First to bring a reasoning model to image generation; 1K/2K/4K resolution tiers
Up to 16 reference images per call, each up to 100MB
gpt-image-2.notes: The model behind ChatGPT Images 2.0. Supports the Batch API, so it still wins on price for bulk work.
gpt-image-2.pricing: Image input $8 / output $30 per 1M tokens (~$0.03–0.08 per image)

gpt-image-1-5.tagline: Late last year's ChatGPT Images workhorse
highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1238, image edit 1370, #15 on both
4x faster than GPT-Image-1, API price cut 20%
Qwen-Image-2.1 is within 3 points of its edit score

sora-2-pro.tagline: The funniest video model, now shut down
highlights: LMArena text-to-video 1368, #11, about 150 points behind #1
Sora app closed in April 2026; API shut down September 24
No replacement from OpenAI; Altman hints at a return to video
sora-2-pro.notes: Some third-party apps still show a Sora option after shutdown; the community is calling for the retired weights to be released.

sora-2.tagline: The gen that lit up short-video social, retired
highlights: LMArena text-to-video 1343, #17
API officially shut down on September 24, 2026
On shutdown day, 31 of 70 tested apps were still serving it

gpt-6-1-sol.tagline: Astra-class work at one-fifth the price
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 52, 1 point behind GPT-6 Astra at under 1/4 the cost per task
Code Arena WebDev 1759, #3, above Fable 5.1
Official: DeepSWE v1.1 level with Astra, OSWorld 2.0 just 2.1 points behind
$2/$10, same as GPT-6 Sol, with cached input cut to $0.10
gpt-6-1-sol.notes: Levels low to max merged; Ultrafast is a speed tier, not a model, and a 6.1 Sol version is still to come. Not on the Text or Agent Arena; writing and front-end reputation trail Claude 5.5.

bench.AA Intelligence Index: max; #6 after per-model dedup (Opus 5.5 at 58, Sonnet 5.5 at 56, Fable 5.1, Astra and Gemini 4 Argon at 53); low 42 / medium 48 / high 50 / xhigh 51
bench.Code Arena WebDev: #3 (max, only 1,264 votes; Opus 5.5 at 1818, Astra at 1789, Fable 5.1 at 1751, 9/30 board)
bench.AA Coding Agent Index: AA's figure: at max, 3 points above GPT-6 Sol and 2 below Astra (exact value not seen on the leaderboard page)
bench.Terminal-Bench 4.0: AA-measured gain over GPT-6 Sol; absolute score not found
bench.DeepSWE v1.1: Official; 6.4 points above GPT-6 Sol at about 1/5 the cost of Astra
bench.OSWorld 2.0: Official; about 7 points above GPT-6 Sol at about 1/7 the cost per task of Astra
bench.AutomationBench: Official, medium level, at about 1/3 the cost of Opus 5.5

gpt-6-1-sol.pricing: $2 / $10 per 1M tokens (cached input $0.10; Fast mode at 2x)
